query: SELECT ev.payload->'native_readiness' AS observation, ev.created_at FROM eval_execution_events ev JOIN eval_executions x ON x.id=ev.execution_id JOIN eval_experiments e ON e.id=x.experiment_id WHERE e.owner_id=$1 AND ev.payload->'native_readiness'->'target'=$2 ORDER BY ev.created_at DESC, ev.sequence DESC LIMIT 1
